release_notes: Responsive Update Sheet: Fixed the modal bottom sheet overflow on all mobile screen heights; action buttons are now permanently visible.
Resilient Chunked OTA Downloads: Added automatic HTTP Range resume across network hiccups and connection drops (up to 5 automatic retries).
Dynamic Version Resolution: Device packages query Android's package manager dynamically for reliable update checks.
Transparent Brand Logo: Applied clean ribbon logo without background across the app and admin console.
Multi-Modal Notes Editor: Vector canvas sketch drawing, rich text formatting, checklist blocks, and audio/file attachments.
Folder Organization & Safe Trash: Hierarchical folders with soft deletion and restore.
Escalating Alerts: Configurable repetitive reminder intervals for critical tasks.
Customizable Tunes: Super Admin–managed audio tunes catalog.
Unified Task & Schedule View: Monthly dot indicators linked to tasks and daily habits.
